gen.title: Quick check on SI structure and values

cards.stem: How many prefixes are currently recognized for use?
cards.quote: Twenty-four prefixes ranging from 10^30 to 10^−30, are currently recognized for use.

cards.stem: How is the value of a physical quantity expressed?
options: product of a number and a unit
sum of a proton charge and a constant
cards.quote: The value of a physical quantity is the quantitative expression of a particular physical quantity as the product of a number and a unit

cards.stem: What foundation does the SI rest on?
cards.quote: The SI rests on a foundation of seven (7) defining constants

cards.stem: Which group forms the core set of SI units?
cards.quote: Together the base units and derived units with special names (twenty-nine units) form the core set of SI units.

checks.message: every quiz text length, id pattern and id uniqueness is within the frozen limits
all 4 card quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quote-verbatim)
every card's correct answer options[0] occurs in its quote after normalisation, with any numbers matching as whole signed numbers (answer-in-quote)
every card has distinct options after normalisation, with no two options spelling the same number (options-distinct)
no stem contains its own correct answer (stem-no-answer-leak)
exactly one option per card matches the quote (one-correct)
every number in stems, options and hints appears on the cited page or in the same quote as that whole signed number (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
